requirement.text: A detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use should be prepared and available to customers upon request.

initial_eus.title: Documentation of Data Use Extent
initial_eus.description: As a customer, I want a detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use to be available to me upon request, so that I can examine how the system uses data.
work_items: A detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use shall be prepared.
The document shall be made available to customers upon request.

analysis.ethical_objective: Transparency toward customers regarding the extent of the system's data use, so that customers can understand how the system uses data.

obligations.text: A detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use shall be prepared.
obligations.source_span: A detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use should be prepared

obligations.text: The document shall be made available to customers upon their request.

constraints: The document must explain the extent of the system's data use.
Availability is triggered by a customer request; the source does not require proactive distribution.
ambiguities: The level of detail required for the document is not specified.
What 'extent of the system's data use' covers (e.g., data categories, purposes, recipients, retention) is not defined.
The form, format, or channel through which the document is made available is not specified.
Who is responsible for preparing the document is not stated.
No timeframe for responding to a request is given.
Whether 'customers' includes prospective customers or other users is not clarified.
No requirement to keep the document up to date is stated.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific format (e.g., PDF, web page) or delivery channel.
Do not assume a response time or frequency for providing the document.
Do not assume the document must be publicly published or proactively delivered without request.
Do not assume specific content sections, legal compliance frameworks, or regulatory obligations.
Do not assume a review, update, or approval process for the document.
Do not assume the document must be available to non-customers.
possible_operational_aspects: Preparation of a detailed document describing the extent of the system's data use.
Provision of the document to a customer when the customer requests it.

work_items.explanation: The work item requires preparation of a detailed document explaining the extent of the system's data use, directly expressing O1.
The work item requires the document to be made available to customers upon request, directly expressing O2 including the request-triggered availability constraint.
